name: hospital-mis
description: Multi-tenant Hospital MIS for Indian clinics/hospitals. Root workspace holds backend (Supabase) tooling only; the Next.js app lives in apps/web.

scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public > supabase/types/database.types.ts
scripts.test:local: npm run typecheck && npm run test:rls && npm run test:onboarding
scripts.verify:remote: npm run db:seed:reset && npm run test:rls:remote
